items.goal: Change the bag page's remove button accessible name from 'Remove <product> from your bag' to 'Remove <product> from your shopping bag'. Leave the visible text 'Remove' and what the button does unchanged. The verifier sets up its own data: sign in as alice, add 'Wanderer Black Hiking Boots' to the bag, then open /cart.
items.verifyReason: The fix changes an accessible name that a person or screen reader sees on the cart page.
